blurb: Canebrake Club features an 18-hole championship golf course designed by Ron Garl, five fast-dry clay tennis courts with USTA certified coaching, and a pool. The club offers golf and tennis lessons, equipment shops, and reservation-only social events for members and their families. It is a community-focused club promoting an active outdoor lifestyle and fine dining.
